title: Chargers' Mike McDaniel on poor offensive showing in Week 1 loss: 'Kind of shocking'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Chargers' Mike McDaniel on poor offensive showing in Week 1 loss: 'Kind of shocking'
sources.description: Los Angeles Chargers OC Mike McDaniel did not expect his unit to play as poorly as it did against the Arizona Cardinals in a 26-14 loss.
